name: org_shared_store
description: C6 brief 47 scenario 4 (independent institution): two factions, each of four founding adults in two couple households with a hut and a small store of roots, on a lean island (fewer berry bushes and root patches, slow regrowth), so a household runs short while another carries food. Every adult knows the 'store food' practice (Orgs.C6.StartPractices = 2, the shared food store template). Organisations on with emergence: a shared store can be founded only by people who themselves felt the need, believe trusted others of another household share it, propose, are accepted and meet. Nothing scripted, no player. Controls: org_shared_store_nopractice (practice absent), org_shared_store_equal (food plentiful). 20 sim days.
